description: The OpenUGD package family as the tools see it. 'root' holds one checkout per package repo, in a folder named after the repo; OPENUGD_ROOT or --root overrides it. Relative paths here ('root', 'smokeProject', 'il2cppSmokeProject') are relative to the upm-tools folder; the committed defaults are the maintainer's layout (upm-tools in <workspace>/v2/repos/, the packages under <workspace>/OpenUGD/Assets), so on another machine pass --root or set OPENUGD_ROOT (README.md, Quick start). 'packages' is the default set for level1/level2, in dependency order: the six packages released together as 2.0.0 ('the train'). 'sourceBranch', each 'target', 'finishExtra' and 'held' are read only by finish.sh, a maintainer-only script that fast-forwards 'target' to the source branch in the maintainer's local repositories.

release.description: release-check.sh: the version the train is tagged as (each tag equals package.json 'version', no prefix, as the existing tags are) and the 'unity' minimum every package declares (Unity 6000.0).

outsideTrain.note: com.openugd.configuration 0.x: checked by level 1 when listed with --packages; not part of the 2.0 release and has no main checkout yet.
